text_block_list.text: (To think just washing my face would hurt this much...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...It's not unbearable.
Right now, training is more important...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega ended up prioritizing her training
over taking care of her rough skin...
